title: Production Test Engineer, Hyvinkää
description:
About the role

As a Production test Engineer, you will work primarily onsite in Hyvinkää, focusing on production testing and test system support. You will provide technical support for test stations, perform troubleshooting, and participate in modifications, updates, and development activities. You will collaborate closely with a team of engineers and gain valuable experience in a global environment.

You are offered

Be part of a collaborative team of designers and testers, contributing to the development of current product versions. Benefit from a supportive environment where your initiative and self-direction are valued.
- A role where you will directly contribute to the quality and reliability of products
- An opportunity to grow professionally and develop your expertise in testing and test systems
- A collaborative and encouraging work environment
- Lunch benefit
- Yearly financial support for academic development
- As a consultant at Academic Work, you are offered the chance to extend your network and establish valuable contacts for the future

Work tasks
- Provide technical support for test stations
- Troubleshoot and perform updates or modifications to test systems
- Support test system development activities
- Collaborate with the production testing team and other engineers
- Read and work with wiring diagrams and electrical schematics
- Use measurement instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, etc.)

We are looking for

- Ms.c or Bs.c in electrical, electronics or automation engineer or equivalent fundamental knowledge in electrical engineering
- Ability to read wiring diagrams and electrical schematics
- Some experience of production testing
- Basic knowledge of LabVIEW
- Basic knowledge of measurement instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, etc.)
- Some understanding of communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART)
- Strong communication skills in English (Finnish is an advantage)
- Good teamwork skills and motivation to learn and develop
- Desire to develop personal skills and motivation for on-the-job learning
- Aspiration to work and succeed as a Test Equipment Engineer

Additional advantages:
- Experience with TestStand
- Experience in electrical design or electrical installations
- Experience with PCBAs and related components
- Interest in test methods and test development

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Suomen kielen kouluttaja/vastuukouluttaja
description:
Laptuote-säätiö hakee vastuukouluttajaa Etelä-Karjalan työllisyysalueelle suunniteltuun toiminnalliseen suomen kielen kotoutumiskoulutukseen. Koulutus on tarkoitettu erityisesti osallistujille, joiden suomen kielen taito on pääsääntöisesti tasolla A1.1–A1.3 ja jotka hyötyvät hitaammin etenevästä, käytännönläheisestä ja vahvasti tuetusta opetuksesta. Tehtävä täytetään, mikäli Laptuote-säätiö valitaan palveluntuottajaksi.

Vastuukouluttajana vastaat suomen kielen opetuksesta, koulutuksen toteutuksesta, etenemisen seurannasta ja osallistujien ohjauksesta. Määrittelet toiminnallisen oppimisen kielelliset tavoitteet ja työvalmentajat toimivat omissa oppimisympäristöissään toiminnallisen oppimisen ohjaajina. Oppimisympäristöinä ovat Goodwill-kierrätysmyymälä ja tuotanto, pesula, keittiö- ja siivouspaja, puupaja, mediapaja sekä sote-paja.

Valittavalla henkilöllä tulee olla suoritettuna opettajan pedagoginen pätevyys (vähintään 35 ov/ 60 op) sekäjoko suomen kielen tai S2-opintoja (vähintään perus-/aineopintokokonaisuus).

**Keskeiset työtehtävät:**

\- suomen kielen opetuksen suunnittelu ja toteutus OPH-649-2022-perusteiden mukaisesti (A1.1–A1.3 taso)

\- toiminnallisen oppimisen kielellisten tavoitteiden määrittely ja työpajajaksojen pedagoginen koordinointi;

\- osallistujien oppimisen seuranta;

\- osallistujien henkilökohtainen ohjaus, opiskelumotivaation tukeminen, jatkopolkujen suunnittelu ja kirjallisen loppupalautteen laatiminen;

\- kehitetystä asiakkaan jatkosuunnitelmasta ja siihen liittyvistä konkreettisista jatkotoimenpiteistä

\- yhteistyö tilaajan, työpajojen työvalmentajien ja muun tarvittavan verkoston kanssa.

\- koulutuksen päätyttyä kouluttajan tulee antaa asiakaskohtainen kirjallinen palaute asiakkaan kielitaidosta ja koulutuksen aikana

Lisätietoja toiminnastamme: www.laptuote.fi.

title: Front Desk / Vastaanottotyöntekijä
description:
Etsimme joukkoomme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja reipasta tekijää, joka viihtyy ihmisten parissa ja pitää vaihtelevista työpäivistä. Tässä tehtävässä olet tärkeä osa asiakkaidemme kokemusta – aina ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta tervetulotoivotukseen ja vierailun viimeisiin hetkiin saakka.

Työpäiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntitehtävistä. Vastaat asiakkaiden vastaanotosta sekä sisään- ja uloskirjautumisista, hoidat varauksia ja palvelet asiakkaita paikan päällä, puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse. Lisäksi pääset tekemään myyntityötä ja löytämään asiakkaille sopivia ratkaisuja heidän tarpeisiinsa.

Toivomme sinulta sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa – muu kielitaito on ehdottomasti plussaa. Arvostamme hyvää paineensietokykyä, oma-aloitteista ja positiivista asennetta sekä perustason tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta käyttää varausjärjestelmiä.

Me tarjoamme sinulle kansainvälisen ja ihmisläheisen työympäristön, rennon ja tiiviin työporukan tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi asiakaspalvelun ja matkailualan parissa. Meillä pääset kohtaamaan erilaisia ihmisiä, oppimaan uutta ja olemaan mukana luomassa asiakkaille mukavia kokemuksia joka päivä.

title: Keikkalaiseksi Honkalammen asumispalveluihin (lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja)
description:
Etsitkö joustavaa ja elämääsi sopivaa tapaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Haemme keikkalaisia **ohjaajan tehtäviin**Honkalampi-säätiön asumispalveluihin. Taustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi lääkeluvallinen**lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja.**

Honkalampi-säätiöllä tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista aikuisille, jotka tarvitsevat tukea arkeensa. Tuen tarpeen taustalla voi olla esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä on koteja **ympäri Pohjois-Karjalaa**: Ilomantsissa, Lieksassa, Polvijärvellä, Outokummussa, Liperissä, Kontiolahdella, Hammaslahdessa ja Joensuussa. Haemme keikkalaisia kaikkiin koteihimme, erityisesti **Ilomantsiin, Lieksaan ja Polvijärvelle**.

Meillä arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää. Huolehdimme turvallisesta ympäristöstä, jossa vuorovaikutus ja monipuoliset kommunikaation keinot ovat keskiössä. Haluamme, että kotimme on paikka, jossa jokainen tulee kuulluksi, ymmärretyksi ja kohdatuksi omana itsenään. Meillä koti on koti.

**Millaista työ on?**

Ohjaajana tuet ja mahdollistat asukkaidemme arkea heidän omien toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja tavoitteidensa mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu hoitotyötä ja hyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä asukkaiden avustamista arjen askareissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa käynnissä ja ulkoilussa.

Lisäksi suunnittelet ja toteutat yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toiveistaan lähtevää yhteistä toimintaa, joka voi olla esimerkiksi liikkumista, leivontaa, pelaamista, retkiä, digitaitojen harjoittelua tai ihan vain yhdessä olemista ja jutustelua.

Keikkalaisena toimit ohjaajan sijaisuuksissa tarpeen mukaan. Keikat voivat olla äkillisiä ja lyhyitä poissaolojen tuurauksia, mutta tarjoamme myös pidempiä sijaisuuksia ensisijaisesti keikkalaisillemme. Voit itse päättää, mitkä keikkapyynnöt hyväksyt.

**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme kehitysvamma-alasta kiinnostuneita, ihmisläheisiä ja vastuullisia keikkalaisia. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja sekä valmiutta ottaa vastaan sijaisuuksia myös lyhyellä varoitusajalla. Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa sote-alan koulutusta (esim. lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, sosionomi) tai vähintään 2/3 alan opinnoista suoritettuna

- lääkehoidon koulutusta ja voimassa olevia lääkelupia

- tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa

- hygieniapassia ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvitystä.


Valitun työntekijän tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkua.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- joustavan, elämääsi sopivan tavan tehdä töitä keikkalaisena

- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen tuntipalkan (kelpoisuusehdot täyttävän ohjaajan palkkaluokka G20C)

- huolellisen perehdytyksen keikkalaisen tehtäviin

- kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän esihenkilön ja työyhteisön tuen.


Pääset osaksi ainutlaatuisten asukkaidemme arkea, saat arvokasta kokemusta kehitysvamma-alalta ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoiset työkaverit - meillä et jää yksin.

**Näin haet meille töihin**

Täytä hakemuslomake nettisivuillamme: https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/

Lisätietoja tehtävistä voit kysyä osoitteesta rekrytointi@hl-s.fi .

Voit tutustua asumispalveluiden arkeen Facebookissa: @Honkalampi Asumispalvelut tai Instagramissa: @honkalampiasumispalvelut .

_Honkalampi on yhteiskuntavastuullinen yritys, jonka tavoitteena on pykälää parempi maailma. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen. Tutustu meihin lisää osoitteessa www.honkalampi.fi ._

_Honkalammen asumispalvelut on savuton työpaikka._

title: Guide-Driver in Lapland
description:

title: Etsimme talvikaudelle työntekijöitä Sodankylän hotellikohteisiimme
description:
Oletko huippuluokan tekijä, anna sen näkyä Peerâssa - etsimme talvikaudelle kokkia ja tarjoilijaa!

Meillä talvikausi 2026–2027 on jo suunnitelmissa. Tarjolla tehokas 4 kk (joulukuu-maaliskuu) rupeama keskellä Lappia, Sodankylässä.

Haluatko hypätä mukavaan ja tekevään työsakkiin ja tuoda omaa osaamista lisäpotkuksi?

Me kaikki olemme tulleet tänne töihin Peerâ Perkele-asenteella ja kyvyllä saattaa asiat loppuun sekä tasapainottaa työ ja vapaa-ajan elämä.

Meillä on tarjolla Sodankylässä 2 hotellia, (toinen uutuutta hohkaava) Hotel Sodankylä sekä Hotel Karhu, yht. 168 huonetta, 2 aamiaisravintolaa, Carte ja Buffet-ravintolat ja kokous-ja juhlapalvelutiloja, Wellness & Spa-osasto, palveluita siis moneen lähtöön E75 varrella.

Ympärillä elämää kihisevä väkevä Sodankylä – ei kaikille, mutta joillekkin kaikki!

Talvikausi on meillä tällä hetkellä ehdoton huippusesonki, mutta toimimme ympärivuotisesti ja tarpeita voi ilmetä myös sulan maan aikana matkailijavirtojen hoitamiseksi.

Myy itsesi meille! Miksi juuri SINÄ olisit upea lisä meidän mahtavaan perheeseen?

Täällä pääset multitaskaamaan ja haastamaan itseäsi myös perinteisen mukavuusalueen ulkopuolella – turvallisesti ja autettuna.

Palkoista pääsemme varmasti yksimielisyyteen kun tieto/taito/osaaminen ja riittävä kokemus/halu kohtaavat. Arvostamme itsenäistä suoriutumista ammattitöistä ja että vapaapäivinä osaat ladata akkusi ja tulla taas pirteänä töihin. Töitä teemme niin kuin asiakkaat meidän palveluitamme käyttävät.

Asuntotilanteessa voimme opastaa eteenpäin, tosin oma-aloitteisuus tietysti on aina arvostettu asia.

Jäitkö pohtimaan? Lähetä siis meili meille Soilelle sekä Railille:

· Vapaamuotoinen hakemus

· Napakka CV

· 2 suosittelijaa alle 5 vuoden työpaikoista yhteystietojen ja aseman kera

Soile Alaraudanjoki: soile.alaraudanjoki@peerahotels.fi sekä Raili Karvonen-Willmanraili.karvonen-willman@peerahotels.fi

Paikkoja koskevat lisätiedustelut myös meilin kautta, kiitos.

Haastattelut tulemme toteuttamaan jatkoon valittujen kera pääsääntöisesti Teams:n välityksellä, jos ei paikan päälle etäisyyksien vuoksi pääse.

Saimme jo kolmannen kerran peräkkäin Great Place to Work sertifikaatin kyseessä ei siis ole Suomen Paskin Työpaikka vaan kuulumme Lapin parhaimmistoon matkailualalla.

Tule antamaan panoksesi seuraavan vuoden sertifikaatteja varten. Olemme nälkäisiä ja kasvuhaluisia. Lue lisää täältä: https://greatplacetowork.fi/sertifioidut/peera-hotels-cottages/

title: Two university lecturers, teaching in the Nanjing-Helsinki Institute
description:
The Faculty of Science invites applications for

TWO UNIVERSITY LECTURERS

starting 1.11.2026 or as agreed.

RESPONSABILITIES
The main duties are teaching for joint bachelor, master and doctoral programs in atmospheric sciences with Nanjing University, supervision of doctoral students and examination of BSc, MSc and PhD theses. The teaching will be performed mainly on-site at Nanjing University campuses in China. The work requires teaching experience in the present degree programmes in atmospheric sciences at the University of Helsinki (ATM-MP and ATM-SciDoc) or equivalent experience of teaching similar courses. The duties of a university lecturer also include research. Working language is English.
QUALIFICATIONS
An ideal candidate has over 2 years of experience in similar duties and expertise in a) or b) clarified below.


a) Expertise in atmospheric chemical transport model development and application, with experience using the CSC – IT Center for Sciences Finnish supercomputing facilities. Research focuses on the atmospheric evolution of aerosol particles, their formation processes, source-attribution analysis and impacts particularly across European and Chinese regions. And teaching experience in aerosol physics, health effects of fine particles, meteorological observations and climate change.
b) Experience in linksbetween plant physiology, carbon and water cycling, and climate resilience across scales from organs to ecosystems using physiologicalexperiments, isotopic analyses, ecosystem measurements, and modeling. And teaching experience in biogeochemistry,biometeorology, forestry and climate change, and quantitative methods including scientific computing and statistics.

We appreciate experience in teaching in the Nanjing degree programme. Pedagogical training is considered as a merit.

The appointee of the university lecturer shall hold an applicable doctoral degree and be able to provide high-quality research-based teaching. The degree requirement must be met before the end of the application period.

WHAT WE OFFER
University of Helsinki is an equal opportunity employer and offers an attractive and diverse workplace with a variety of development opportunities and benefits. The salary is based on the salary system of Finnish universities. The salary range is from 4600-5300 euros per month depending on the qualifications and seniority of the selected candidate.

The University of Helsinki is committed to promoting equality and preventing discrimination in all its operations. The University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care and health insurance, sports facilities, and opportunities for professional development

HOW TO APPLY
Applications shall be submitted through the University of Helsinki´s recruitment system and include the following documents:

* a motivation letter
* a university portfolio (please see https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-of-science/faculty/join-us/academic-portfolio)

External applicants, please submit your application via the Apply Now button.

Internal applicants, who have a helsinki.fi username and a valid employment/grant/visitor contract, please submit your application via the Employee login button.

The deadline for applications is 9.9.2026.

FURTHER INFORMATION

Further information may be obtained:

* About the position and the operational environment from Research Director Katja Lauri, katja.lauri(at)helsinki.fi and Research Coordinator Tom Kokkonen, tom.kokkonen(at)helsinki.fi.

* About the recruitment process and the recruitment system recruitment(at)helsinki.fi.


Institute for Atmospheric and Earth System Research (INAR) is a multi- and interdisciplinary research unit based in physics, chemistry, meteorology, forest sciences, environmental sciences and social sciences in the University of Helsinki. INAR aims to strengthen the internationally leading, integrated multidisciplinary research and education environment for atmospheric and Earth system science and to feed in scientific results for the national and international environment and climate policy. It performs multiscale research from molecular to global scale and focuses on climate change, air quality, biogeochemical cycles and ecosystem processes. INAR is part of the Atmosphere and Climate Competence Centre (ACCC), a Research Council of Finland flagship programme, with partners in Finnish Meteorological Institute, University of Eastern Finland and Tampere University.

The UH Faculty of Science is an equal opportunity workplace committed to advance wellbeing and diversity in science and education. We welcome applicants from a variety of genders, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities. We support the compatibility of work and family-life and promote gender equality in science.

title: Mechanical Engineering Trainee / Thesis Worker at Geberit's Ceramic Factory in Ekenäs, Finland
description:

Join Geberit's ceramic factory in Ekenäs and gain valuable hands-on experience in a unique manufacturing environment. Our factory produces bathroom ceramics under the IDO, Ifö, Porsgrund and Geberit brands.

You will work with machine components used in pressure casting technology for ceramic production.

We are looking for someone who:

- Is looking for a trainee position or thesis project opportunity.

title: Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator (Levi)
description:
Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator
Levi, Lapland, Scandinavian Travel Group

We are looking for a reliable, energetic and hands-on Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator to join our team in Levi for the winter season 2026–2027.
This role supports the smooth daily flow of our winter operations. You will keep guest clothing and equipment clean, dry and ready for departures, assist guests with outfitting, and help maintain a clean and organized office environment.

WORK LOCATION & CONDITIONS
- Location: Scandinavian Travel Group office, Keskuskuja 2 B, Levi
- Working mode: Full-time, on-site
- Main office language: English
- Contract period: fixed-term employment 01.11.2026–31.03.2027
- Application deadline: 31.07.2026

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Winter clothing and gear management
-Cleaning, drying, disinfecting, sorting and organizing winter clothing and equipment
-Preparing correct sizes and clothing sets for guest departures
-Checking the condition of overalls, boots, helmets and other equipment
-Handling basic replacements, repairs and maintenance needs
-Keeping simple washing and maintenance records
2.Guest outfitting
-Helping guests dress and undress before and after activities
-Selecting correct sizes for overalls, boots, helmets and other gear
-Advising guests on layering and staying warm in Arctic conditions
-Providing friendly, efficient and practical customer service during busy departure times
3.Office housekeeping
-Keeping the kitchen, staff areas, front desk zone and entrance clean, safe and organized
-Supporting daily cleanliness in customer-facing and staff areas
-Maintaining a tidy and professional working environment throughout the day

REQUIREMENTS
-Good English skills are required.
-Valid Category B drivers license (minimum) and good driving experience are required.
-Previous cleaning, housekeeping, laundry or equipment maintenance experience is an advantage.
-Additional languages such as Spanish, French, German or Dutch are considered an advantage.

IDEAL PROFILE
-You are practical, reliable, positive and self-disciplined. You are physically ready for active work during a busy winter season, attentive to cleanliness and details, and comfortable working with international guests and colleagues.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Contract type
This is a fixed-term seasonal employment contract. The fixed-term nature is justified by the seasonal peak of the winter travel business in Lapland.

Salary and working hours
Contract type: fixed monthly salary
Starting monthly salary: €2,560 gross
Included working hours: average 37.5–40 hours per week

Supplements
Sunday and official public holiday work is compensated with a 100% pay increase according to Finnish law.
Evening and night work is compensated according to the applicable Program Services Sector Collective

Agreement (Ohjelmapalvelualan TES).
Working time averaging
Due to the seasonal nature of our work, we use a working time averaging arrangement under Finnish law and the applicable collective agreement. Working hours are averaged over the contract period. A work schedule is prepared in advance for each period.

WHAT WE PROVIDE
- Accommodation: a private room in the Levi area can be provided. Rent is €400 per person per month + electricity, under a separate fixed calendar-month lease agreement.
- Work clothing: warm workwear and necessary protective equipment are provided.
- Training: practical onboarding and work-specific training before and during the season.
- Transport: company cars may be used for transport from accommodation to the Levi office according to schedule and availability.
- Connectivity: work phone with a Finnish SIM may be provided depending on work needs.
- Insurance paid by the company: mandatory accident insurance during work, additional free-time accident insurance and additional health insurance.

ADDITIONAL PERKS
- Access to a shared seasonal ski pass for Levi slopes
- Possibility of local Levi fitness club membership
- Local worker discounts at selected restaurants and shops via Levi Passi
- Friendly international team and lively winter season atmosphere

HOW TO APPLY
Please send your CV and additional information in English to hr@gostg.fi.
Subject line: Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator — Levi
Please mention your earliest possible start date, relevant experience, language skills and whether you need accommodation in Levi.
Application deadline: 31.07.2026.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
Senior Financial Controller

Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

Finance Competence Center (FCC) is a centralized financial unit providing accounting services for 26 legal units in 13 countries in Europe and North America.

As a Senior Financial Controller, you will play a key role in financial reporting and controlling of Nokian Tyres Group. You will be part of Groups global finance team preparing and supporting in subsidiaries globally.

You will work closely together with business control team and other stakeholders. We expect you to have experience of working in a challenging, international business environment and you have ability and motivation to drive continuous improvement. You have open-minded approach and self-driven working style.

Key responsibilities:

- Participate in monthly/quarterly/yearly reporting (including asset accounting, inventory accounting, taxation etc.) and closing
- Provide financial analysis and reconciliation
- Ensure accuracy of financial records, financial closing, and reporting
- Manage fixed assets processes, including capitalization, depreciation, and disposals.
- Ensure the correctness of figures by controlling and analyzing the account information and results
- Oversee and lead the annual closing, statutory financial reporting and audit
- Support and instruct other team members in accounting and taxation related issues
- Develop and harmonize global financial processes, policies, and quality of operations
- Participate to development and automation activities in accounting and finance
- Participate in forecasting and optimizing tax position

What we expect from you:

- Applicable education, e.g., Masters degree in accounting
- Work experience in similar field of responsibility area
- Knowledge in accounting, taxation and reporting processes is required, IFRS is an advantage
- Advanced Excel skills and experience from creating and developing new reporting tools
- Good team-working and communication skills both in English and Finnish, other languages are considered an advantage
- Analytical developer mindset to improve and harmonize processes
- Ability to work under pressure and responsibility
- Compliance with policies, processes and procedures is obvious to you

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Please note that prerequisite of the employment is that the selected employee has a valid residence and work permit in Finland.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please fill in the application form with CV and salary request by 28th August 2026. We will be starting the interviews as soon as we receive potential applications, so dont wait too long!

For further information please contact: Katja Vikki, tel +358 50 301 5551 e-mail katja.vikki@nokiantyres.com. You can best reach her on Aug 24th, 9-10.00, Aug 26th 8.30-9.30 or Aug 28th 8-10.00.

title: Doctoral Researchers in Literary Studies or History (Verses of Learning: Epideixis and Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities)/ 1–2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa, kirjallisuustiede tai historia
description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

title: Erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilöitä Helsinkiin
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilöitä Helsinkiin.**

Haemme Helsingin alueelle erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilöitä tuleviin asiakkuuksiin. Rakennamme osaajaverkostoa kasvavaan palvelutarpeeseen, ja tarjoamme työtä asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaisesti. Tällä hetkellä asiakkaille myönnetyt palvelutunnit ovat vähintään 20 tuntia kuukaudessa, mutta tuntimäärät voivat vaihdella asiakkuuden mukaan.

Erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilönä mahdollistat asiakkaalle osallistumisen hänelle merkitykselliseen toimintaan. Työssä tuet asiakkaan vuorovaikutusta, osallisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä sekä kannustat häntä löytämään mielekästä tekemistä omien kiinnostuksenkohteidensa mukaisesti. Työssä korostuvat läsnäolo, kohtaamisen taito ja yksilöllinen ohjaus

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet helposti lähestyttävä, kärsivällinen ja aidosti kiinnostunut kohtaamaan erilaisia ihmisiä. Osaat toimia asiakkaan rinnalla kannustavasti ja hänen yksilöllisiä tarpeitaan kuunnellen. Sinulle on luontevaa tukea asiakkaan osallistumista arjen toimintoihin, harrastuksiin ja sosiaalisiin tilanteisiin sekä löytää yhdessä uusia mahdollisuuksia mielekkääseen tekemiseen.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES

- Joustavan työajan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Sosiaalialan koulutusta

- Kiinnostusta vammaistyöhön

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- Selkeää vuorovaikutusta, läsnäoloa ja itsenäistä työotetta


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. EOT-tukihenkilön tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

title: Tarjoilija
description:
Palkittu RUNO Hotel Porvoo sai alkunsa unelmasta luoda huipputason hotellielämys, joka on reilusti arjen yläpuolella, mutta silti helposti lähestyttävä ja luokseen kutsuva. Hotellin ravintola RUNO Kitchen ammentaa suomalaisesta ruokakulttuurista ja paikallisista mauista tarjoillen laadukasta aamiaista, lounasta, viikonloppubrunsseja, yksityistilaisuuksia ja huonepalvelua.

Etsimme nyt tiimiimme tarjoilijaa 60h sopimuksella, mutta sesonki aikaan työvuoroja on tarjolla enemmänkin. Tässä tehtävässä tärkeintä on aito kiinnostus asiakaspalveluun – nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta, olet aidosti läsnä asiakkaalle ja haluat omalla tekemiselläsi luoda lämpimän, välittömän ja laadukkaan RUNO-kokemuksen.

Työ painottuu pääsääntöisesti aamu- ja päivävuoroihin erityisesti viikonloppuina ja pyhäpäivinä, mutta työvuoroja on tarjolla myös arkipäivisin ja satunnaisesti myös iltapainotteisesti. Tehtävässä työskentelet monipuolisesti aina hotelliaamiaisista ja viikonloppubrunsseista lounaisiin ja erilaisiin tilaisuuksiin. Päivääsi kuuluu asiakkaiden vastaanottamista ja palvelemista, ruoka- ja juomatarjoilua sekä buffetin ja salin sujuvasta toiminnasta huolehtimista. Lisäksi vastaat kassasta, päivittäisistä valmisteluista sekä avaus- ja sulkutehtävistä ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä keittiön ja muun tiimin kanssa.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vähintään 2 vuoden aikaisempaa kokemusta ravintola-alalta

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen taitoa pidämme suurena etuna

- asiakaslähtöistä ja positiivista asennetta

- kykyä työskennellä kiireessä ja pitää kokonaisuus hallussa myös vilkkaina päivinä

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua tehdä hyvää yhteistyötä muun tiimin kanssa

- kiinnostusta laadukkaaseen palveluun ja halua tehdä asiakkaan päivästä hieman paremman.


Tarjoamme sinulle nuoren, kunnianhimoisen ja välittävän työympäristön, jossa haluamme jatkuvasti kehittää tekemistämme ja luoda Suomen parhaisiin kuuluvia hotellin ja ravintolan elämyksiä. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen tiimin jäsen pääsee vaikuttamaan, oppimaan ja kasvamaan osana yhteisöä. Palkkauksessa noudatetaan matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaa työntekijöiden työehtosopimusta, jossa otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus.

Jos olet energinen, oma-aloitteinen ja aidosti asiakaspalveluhenkinen sekä haluat olla mukana luomassa RUNOn vieraille hetkiä, jotka jäävät mieleen, haluamme kuulla sinusta!

Lähetä avoin hakemuksesi sekä ansioluettelosi osoitteeseen maija.koittola@runohotel.com.

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer (Data Center)
description:
**About us**

Established in 2006, Nordecon Oy is a multinational OEM company and solution provider specializing in complex end-to-end mobile, server, and custom-built desktop solutions. With nearly two decades of experience and a strong track record in delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions, the company is pivoting towards new opportunities. We are building a modern AI-focused Data Center in Finland designed for high-density GPU computing. Our infrastructure is being built from the ground up, giving you the opportunity to influence every aspect of the network architecture instead of maintaining legacy systems.

We are looking for an experienced Network & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys designing, building and operating reliable infrastructure.

**What you will do**

You will be responsible for designing, implementing and operating the entire network infrastructure of the data center.

This role combines architecture, implementation and day-to-day technical ownership.

**Network Architecture**

- Design the complete data center network from the ground up.

- Develop scalable and resilient network architecture.

- Design physical fibre topology.

- Design IP addressing strategy.

- Design VLAN and VRF structure.

- Design rack connectivity standards.

- Produce and maintain network documentation.

- Plan future expansion of the infrastructure.


**External Connectivity**

- Design and maintain multi-ISP connectivity.

- Configure and operate BGP.

- Design Internet redundancy and failover.

- Coordinate network connectivity with providers.

- Plan future interconnection between multiple data center locations.


**Internal Network**

- Deploy and maintain switches, routers and firewalls.

- Configure Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking.

- Build management and out-of-band networks.

- Maintain network security.

- Troubleshoot complex networking issues.

- Support high-speed Ethernet environments (25G / 100G / 400G).


**Monitoring & Automation**

- Build network monitoring and alerting.

- Integrate infrastructure into monitoring platforms.

- Automate repetitive operational tasks.

- Maintain accurate documentation.

- Improve operational reliability.


**Infrastructure Integration**

Work closely with electrical and mechanical contractors to integrate infrastructure into a unified monitoring platform.

Examples include:

- UPS

- Generators

- Cooling systems

- Water pumps

- Fire detection systems

- Environmental monitoring

- Building Management System (BMS)


Experience with Modbus, BACnet or similar industrial protocols is an advantage but **not required**.

**Required Skills**

- Strong networking knowledge.

- Experience designing and deploying enterprise or data center networks.

- Cisco, Juniper, Arista or similar platforms.

- TCP/IP.

- BGP.

- OSPF.

- VLAN.

- LACP.

- Linux administration.

- Fibre networking.

- Excellent troubleshooting skills.

- Good documentation practices.

- Ability to independently deliver technical projects.


**Nice to Have**

- EVPN / VXLAN.

- Spine-Leaf architectures.

- Network automation.

- Python.

- Ansible.

- Grafana.

- Prometheus.

- Zabbix.

- GPU cluster networking.

- AI/HPC infrastructure.

- Kubernetes.

- Docker.

- Modbus.

- BACnet.


**What we are looking for**

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building infrastructure rather than simply maintaining existing environments.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions, designing solutions from scratch and implementing them yourself.

You don't need to know everything. We value strong networking fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.

**What we offer**

- Opportunity to build a modern AI Data Center from the ground up.

- Freedom to influence technical decisions.

- Modern infrastructure.

- High level of technical ownership.

- Long-term career growth.

- Competitive salary based on experience.


**Work Setup**

Location: Riihimäki, Finland (hybrid work possible but on-site presence required at times)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience. Start: As soon as a suitable candidate is found but the start date is flexible.

**Interested?**

Send your CV, short introduction, and salary request to **applications@nordecon.fi**.

If you have questions, feel free to reach out, were happy to discuss the role in more detail.

**Please note:** Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond individually to each applicant. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Account Manager
description:
Carpenter Co. is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, serving a diverse global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide. Our Kouvola facility produces traditional comfort solutions, mattresses (both consumer & medical) and technical foams including rolls and bonded foam applications.

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Finnish team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing sales and strengthening Carpenter's market position in Finland. You will work closely with existing customers while actively identifying new business opportunities within the manufacturing industry. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of your customer portfolio, influence commercial strategy, and contribute directly to business growth in a global market-leading company.

What you'll do

- Drive the commercial growth of Carpenter Comfort Solutions in Finland.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and key stakeholders.

- Identify, pursue, and convert new business opportunities and market segments.

- Develop and execute sales plans aligned with business objectives.

- Monitor market developments, customer needs, and industry trends.

- Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, contracts, and business terms.

- Support profitability by managing pricing strategies and commercial risks.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer experience and business performance.

What we're looking for

- At least 5 years of experience selling materials, components, or technical solutions to manufacturing industry customers.

- Experience managing and developing your own customer portfolio.

- A proven track record in acquiring new customers and growing sales.

- Strong commercial acumen and experience negotiating pricing and contracts.

- Experience developing and implementing sales strategies and business plans.

- The ability to identify market trends and translate them into commercial opportunities.

- Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical sales.

- Experience in polyurethane, furniture or bedding industry.

- Experience managing distributors, dealers, or key accounts in the Nordic market.

- A background in B2B sales and business development.

Location & Travel

This role requires regular travel within Finland to meet customers, develop business opportunities, and support market growth. Our Finnish team is based in Kouvola, and monthly visits to the office are expected.

Apply Now

To ensure a consistent recruitment process, all applications and CVs must be submitted in English through our recruitment system via [this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/account-manager/ZlEGpp) no later than 7 September 2026. We review and interview candidates throughout the application period, and the position may be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.


Carpenter Engineered Foams Oy

Founded in 1950, Carpenter Co. is the worlds largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. Carpenter also serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 70 production locations. Our 6,500+ employees across the globe seek to provide the most innovative products and solutions with a focus on enhancing the quality of peoples lives while being a good steward of our resources.

At Carpenter, you'll find a rewarding career in a stable company, diverse experiences and an unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues whose sense of purpose complements your own.

title: Housekeeper
description:
**Housekeepers for the Winter Season 2026–2027 in Levi, Ylläs and Sodankylä!**

We are looking for enthusiastic seasonal employees for a variety of accommodation destinations in Levi, Ylläs and Sodankylä! How would you like to work in an international environment as part of an energetic and supportive team that values and respects one another?

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace**

N-Clean has been recognized in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-centered and responsible workplace. In 2024, we were awarded Finlands Most Human-Centered Workplace, and in 2025, we achieved third place in both the overall competition and the Most Human-Centered Working Life Act category. These recognitions highlight our people-focused recruitment approach, where respect, meaningful interactions and a positive candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do. Our values – **trust, respect and commitment** – are reflected in our daily work through concrete actions: we keep our promises, take pride in our work and treat each other fairly. Everyone at N-Clean is responsible for their own work and for our shared success. We support one another, even during the busiest times.

**Housekeeper (Hotels and Other Accommodation Properties)**

As a Housekeeper, you are responsible for ensuring that guest rooms, apartments and cabins are clean, comfortable and welcoming. Through your work, you help maintain high quality standards and directly contribute to customer satisfaction with your attention to detail and commitment to excellent service. During the winter season, working hours vary depending on the property. Most shifts are morning shifts ending in the afternoon. Work is available on both weekdays and weekends. In this role, you will perform visible and meaningful work that has a direct impact on guests daily experiences, holidays and overall comfort. You play an important part in creating a successful customer experience. Your workday follows a planned schedule, and you are responsible for ensuring your tasks are completed efficiently, while working together with your team to achieve shared goals. The role requires initiative, planning skills, efficiency and the ability to follow agreed schedules. Quality, safety and friendly customer service are essential parts of everyday work. Completing tasks carefully according to quality and safety standards and interacting with guests in a professional and friendly manner are key aspects of the role. You enjoy a fast-paced work environment, customer service and working effectively in changing situations. Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning hotel rooms, apartments and cabins, including changing linens, making beautiful beds, cleaning bathrooms, cleaning various floor surfaces, wiping surfaces and replenishing room supplies.

- Cleaning public areas, apartment kitchens, cabin kitchens and/or meeting facilities.

- Additional cleaning tasks such as window cleaning.

- **You may also have the opportunity to assist in the heart of the hotel by helping with breakfast service**


**What We Offer**

- A fixed-term part-time employment contract (20–31 hours per week) from November to March. Employment start dates are staggered throughout November and December.

- Varied morning shifts and, in Ylläs, evening/night shifts from 5:00 PM to 11:30 PM.

- A thorough introduction through our renewed onboarding journey and N-Clean Academy. Previous experience in the industry is not required, although it may help you get started more quickly.

- The opportunity to continue working with us after the season.

- Salary according to the Collective Agreement for the Property Services Industry: €11.33–€13.88/hour depending on your duties.

- A genuinely caring work community and supportive supervisors. At N-Clean, seasonal work is more than just a job. It is an opportunity to learn new skills, gain valuable work experience and become part of a community where every contribution is noticed and appreciated.


**What We Expect from You**

- You have a positive and energetic attitude and approach your work with enthusiasm and curiosity. You are eager to learn, complete your tasks carefully and maintain high quality while following agreed schedules.

- You work proactively and with a solution-focused mindset and can handle situations independently. Physical work and varied workdays do not intimidate you; instead, you enjoy being active.

- You are service-minded, flexible and act according to our values in everyday situations. Reliability and a responsible work ethic are reflected in the way you work.

- You work well as part of a team but are also comfortable working independently within your own area of responsibility. Finnish and/or English language skills are required.

- You speak either Finnish or English.

- A driving licence and access to a car will be considered an advantage.

- Please note that if you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit for Finland.


For us, the most important qualities are the right attitude and a willingness to complete work to a high standard, on time and in line with our values. We learn together and support one another so everyone can succeed in their role. You enjoy physical work, take responsibility for your own tasks and complete them with quality and punctuality. You are comfortable working independently and managing your own responsibilities.

**Diversity and Equality**

Our workforce includes people from more than 100 nationalities. We actively promote equality and inclusion and want everyone to feel valued and welcome. Different backgrounds, life situations and experiences are a strength for us.

**Apply Now!**

Submit your application through our website no later than 13 September 2026.

capable de contribuer activement au développement de nouveaux marchés industriels, en priorité le secteur de la Défense, ainsi que d'autres secteurs porteurs (aéronautique, naval, énergie, automobile lourd, infrastructures critiques).

Vos missions :

Prospection et développement commercial

- Prospecter et développer un portefeuille de comptes sur le secteur Défense et d'autres marchés industriels non ferroviaires, en cohérence avec le plan d'action défini par la Responsable Commerciale.
- Identifier et qualifier les opportunités auprès de donneurs d'ordres, intégrateurs et équipementiers pertinents.
- Activer et développer un réseau de contacts dans l'écosystème Défense et les secteurs cibles.
Suivi des affaires
- Assurer le suivi des cycles de vente, souvent longs et multi-interlocuteurs, avec appui technique et réglementaire des équipes internes.

- Remonter les informations de terrain utiles au pilotage du plan d'action commercial et à l'ajustement de l'offre.

Représentation

- Représenter l'entreprise sur les salons et événements professionnels pertinents pour les secteurs ciblés.
- Assurer une veille concurrentielle de terrain sur les marchés visés.

Formation

- Formation Bac+2 à Bac+5, commerciale et/ou technique ; une double compétence technico-commerciale est un atout.

Expérience

Minimum 5 à 8 ans d'expérience commerciale en environnement industriel B2B / B2G
Expérience de ventes à cycle long (12 à 36 mois), impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes et des exigences de conformité fortes.
Connaissance des logiques d'achat des donneurs d'ordres étatiques et des intégrateurs de premier rang.
Habitude des exigences d'habilitation, de sécurité et de traçabilité propres au secteur Défense.

Compétences et savoir-être

- Sens du terrain et de la prospection, capacité à ouvrir de nouveaux comptes sur un marché nouveau pour l'entreprise.
- Capacité à présenter les offres et les défendre d'un point de vue économique et technique.
-  Rompu à la négociation et au closing d'affaires à forts enjeux.
- Bon relationnel, capacité à échanger avec des interlocuteurs techniques et des acheteurs.
- Rigueur dans le suivi d'affaires et le reporting.
- Anglais professionnel opérationnel (TOIEC 800) apprécié pour des relations internationales.
- Autonomie et capacité à travailler en lien étroit avec sa Responsable Commerciale, dans un environnement en structuration.

title: Conducteur livreur / Conductrice livreuse poids lourds (H/F)
description:

Si nos clients peuvent préparer et servir de belles assiettes en temps et en heure, c'est aussi parce que nos chauffeurs-livreurs font le maximum pour les satisfaire.

Alors, en plus d'avoir un permis C, la carte chronotachygraphe ainsi que la FIMO Transport de Marchandises / FCO, ce qui essentiel, c'est avant tout votre personnalité ! Et pour être Chauffeur-livreur H/F, avoir le sens du contact, être rigoureux(se) et autonome, est un vrai plus. Mais ce n'est pas tout. Il faut aussi partager l'état d'esprit Pomona. Car chez nous, les collaborateurs sont passionnés, engagés et ont un vrai sens du collectif !

- Et surtout, c'est bénéficier d'une rémunération attractive : salaire fixe + prime mensuelle, 13ème mois, prime transport, panier repas, intéressement/participation, tarifs préférentiels, activités CSE.

Assurer la continuité et la qualité opérationnelle du pôle CX au quotidien : traitement des demandes clients sur tous canaux, animation terrain des collaborateurs, et suivi d'un portefeuille clients en accompagnement. Premier niveau d'escalade entre l'équipe et le Responsable CX, le coordinateur tranche les décisions opérationnelles courantes et garantit l'atteinte des objectifs de satisfaction et de performance.

Traitement des demandes clients :

- Modéliser les bonnes pratiques d'accompagnement pour l'ensemble de l'équipe.

- Être le premier point de contact opérationnel de l'équipe : arbitrage des cas opérationnels simples, routage entre les pôles SAV, Nutrition et Conseil.

- Remonter au Responsable CX les situations critiques, décisions à enjeu stratégique et sujets RH.

Process & amélioration continue :
- Être garant des process opérationnels : procédures SAV, politiques de remboursement, macros, outils de routage.
- Identifier les irritants récurrents et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes transverses.
- Contribuer au suivi des indicateurs de performance et produire un reporting régulier.

Profil recherché
- 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en service client, CX ou relation client : environnement e-commerce ou BTOC requis.
- Expérience avérée dans un rôle de coordination opérationnelle ou de leadership terrain.
- Appétence pour la nutrition, le sport ou les compléments alimentaires, atout distinctif.

Compétences techniques
- Maîtrise d'un outil de gestion de tickets (Zendesk ou équivalent) : macros, reporting, vues personnalisées.
- Lecture et exploitation des KPIs CX. Capacité à transformer un dashboard en décision opérationnelle.
- Aisance avec les outils d'automation ou forte capacité d'apprentissage.

Posture attendue
- Leadership naturel et forte capacité à fédérer
- Forte personnalité avec des convictions servicielles fortes, une maturité professionnelle à toute épreuve est indispensable..
- Sang-froid en situation de charge élevée. Capacité à absorber la pression sans déstabiliser la dynamique d'équipe.
- Exigence sur les standards collectifs, bienveillance avec les personnes,
- Discernement dans l'escalade : autonomie sur les décisions courantes, transparence sur ce qui remonte.
- Orienté data dans ses prises de décision : capacité à lire les indicateurs du pôle, identifier les signaux faibles et arbitrer sur la base de faits plutôt qu'au ressenti.

title: Chef(fe) d'équipe Propreté polyvalent(e) (H/F) - CDI (H/F)
description:
À propos de Louisiane Propreté
Louisiane Propreté est une entreprise spécialisée dans les prestations de propreté et de services associés. Nous plaçons la qualité de nos prestations, la satisfaction de nos clients et le professionnalisme de nos équipes au cœur de notre activité. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) d'équipe Propreté polyvalent(e) (H/F) capable d'allier compétences opérationnelles, sens de l'organisation et management de proximité.

Votre rôle
Rattaché(e) au Chargé d'exploitation ou au Responsable de secteur, vous êtes un véritable relais opérationnel sur le terrain. Vous assurez l'organisation et le suivi quotidien d'une équipe, veillez à la qualité des prestations, accompagnez les agents et assurez le suivi des demandes clients. Vous pouvez également participer au suivi d'interventions techniques de premier niveau, selon vos compétences et habilitations.

Vos missions
Organisation et management : organiser et adapter le planning quotidien, répartir les tâches selon les priorités et besoins clients, organiser les prestations périodiques, gérer les absences et imprévus, accueillir et intégrer les nouveaux collaborateurs, accompagner les agents sur le terrain, transmettre les bonnes pratiques et contribuer à leur montée en compétences. Faire remonter à l'exploitation ou aux RH les difficultés nécessitant un suivi.

Qualité et relation client : réaliser les contrôles qualité des prestations de propreté, vérifier la conformité des interventions, identifier les non-conformités et suivre les actions correctives. Réceptionner et qualifier les demandes des clients et occupants, distinguer les demandes relevant du contrat ou d'une prestation complémentaire, assurer la traçabilité des interventions et transmettre à l'exploitation les demandes nécessitant un devis ou un arbitrage.

Matériel, prestations techniques et sécurité : suivre les stocks de produits, consommables et matériels, contrôler l'état de l'outillage et signaler les besoins de maintenance ou de remplacement. Veiller à la bonne gestion des clés, badges et accès. Faire appliquer les consignes de sécurité et le port des EPI, veiller au respect des plans de prévention et des règles liées au travail en hauteur et aux interventions électriques. Signaler tout accident, presqu'accident ou situation dangereuse.

Profil recherché
Nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) de terrain expérimenté(e), autonome et polyvalent(e), capable d'encadrer une équipe et de garantir la qualité des prestations. Vous justifiez idéalement de 5 ans d'expérience minimum dans un environnement de propreté, maintenance ou services associés, ainsi que d'une expérience confirmée en tant que chef(fe) d'équipe. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de propreté et le machinisme et disposez de connaissances en maintenance de premier niveau : électricité dans le cadre de l'habilitation détenue, plomberie, serrurerie, menuiserie ou petites réparations. Vous êtes organisé(e), réactif(ve), rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un bon relationnel et capable de gérer les priorités. Le CQP/TFP Chef d'équipe en propreté est apprécié.

Indispensables : habilitation électrique adaptée aux interventions confiées lorsque nécessaire. Le SST, la formation au travail en hauteur et le CACES R486 constituent des atouts.

Conditions du poste
Contrat : CDI - Temps plein. Secteur : Paris et Île-de-France. Déplacements : quotidiens sur différents sites clients, avec transport d'outillage selon les besoins. Horaires : généralement en journée, adaptés à l'activité des sites et aux vacations des équipes. Interventions possibles dans des immeubles, bureaux, commerces, copropriétés, ERP, hôtels, salles de sport, bateaux et péniches. Convention collective : Entreprises de propreté et services associés

description:

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme permettant réglementairement l'exercice des fonctions de direction d'un ACM, notamment
BPJEPS LTP
DEJEPS ou DESJEPS
B.U.T. ou DUT Carrières Sociales, option animation sociale et socioculturelle.

un(e) adjoint(e) référent(e) du secteur maternel ;
un(e) adjoint(e) référent(e) du secteur élémentaire.

Votre rôle est de piloter, organiser, fédérer et accompagner l'ensemble de cette dynamique.

Vos principales missions :
Vous êtes garant(e) de la mise en œuvre et de l'évolution du projet pédagogique, en cohérence avec le projet éducatif de l'association et les orientations de la collectivité.
Vous accompagnez notamment les équipes autour de :
la pédagogie active et la participation de l'enfant ;
l'autonomie, le jeu libre et l'expérimentation ;
l'aménagement des espaces en fonction des besoins des enfants ;
la mise en place de projets autour de l'art, de la musique et de la culture ;
la continuité éducative avec l'école et les familles ;
le développement de nouveaux projets et partenariats.

Vous assurez le management global de la structure et animez directement votre équipe de direction.
Vous êtes notamment chargé(e) de :
coordonner l'équipe de direction et les référent(e)s pédagogiques ;
organiser les ressources humaines et les plannings ;
participer aux recrutements et à l'intégration des professionnels ;
conduire les réunions et temps de coordination ;
accompagner les pratiques professionnelles et les projets ;
favoriser la coopération et la circulation de l'information au sein des équipes.

Garantir la qualité et la sécurité de l'accueil
En tant que Directeur(trice), vous êtes garant(e) du respect de la réglementation des Accueils Collectifs de Mineurs (ACM)
Vous veillez au respect des taux d'encadrement, des qualifications, des procédures de sécurité et des protocoles internes, ainsi qu'à la bonne organisation des sorties et des différents temps d'accueil.

Vous supervisez également le fonctionnement administratif, organisationnel et budgétaire du périscolaire :
- suivi des inscriptions et dossiers familles ;
- suivi des données d'activité et tableaux de bord ;
- bilans et reporting ;
- suivi des dépenses et des besoins matériels ;
- organisation des périodes scolaires et des vacances ;

À propos de l'entreprise

Pour le compte d'un groupe reconnu dans le secteur des travaux publics et du BTP, le cabinet Oz2B recherche un(e) Gestionnaire Administratif(ve) du Personnel H/F.

Rejoindre cette structure, c'est intégrer un environnement axé sur la transparence, l'honnêteté et la clarté des échanges. L'entreprise place l'humain au cœur de sa politique RH : un accompagnement sur-mesure et un plan de formation adapté sont déployés dès votre arrivée pour vous donner toutes les clés de la réussite. Plus qu'un poste opérationnel, il s'agit d'un véritable tremplin professionnel offrant de réelles perspectives d'évolution dans les ressources humaines.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à la direction et en lien avec les différents sites du groupe (périmètre d'environ 140 collaborateurs), vous assurez la gestion administrative complète du personnel et participez activement à la préparation de la paie (externalisée).

1. Administration du personnel & Absences
- Constituer les dossiers d'embauche, préparer les documents d'intégration et maintenir à jour les dossiers individuels,
- Suivre l'ensemble des absences (Maladie, AT/MP, Maternité/Paternité) et effectuer les déclarations (Net-Entreprises, signalements DSN, prévoyance PRO BTP, mi-temps thérapeutiques),
- Assurer le suivi et la relation avec les organismes (CPAM, PRO BTP, CIBTP) ainsi que le paiement des IJSS et indemnités,
- Gérer le volet spécifique BTP : déclarations de congés payés auprès de la CIBTP, suivi des soldes, demandes inter-caisses et déclarations d'intempéries.

2. Préparation de la paie & Sorties
- Collecter, contrôler et mettre en forme les variables de paie issues du logiciel de gestion des temps interne (tableaux de présence, indemnités de déplacement/panier, acomptes, primes, saisies sur salaire, etc.),
- Consulter et vérifier les données sur le logiciel SAGE,
- Gérer le process de sortie : préparation des variables de soldes de tout compte, contrôle, envois des documents officiels et gestion des certificats CIBTP.

3. Reporting & Amélioration continue
- Élaborer les reportings RH mensuels (effectifs, mouvements),
- Participer à la mise à jour des process internes et apporter un soutien opérationnel aux relais RH sur le terrain.

Le profil recherché

- Expérience & Métier : Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie sur un poste similaire. La connaissance des règles et spécificités du secteur du BTP (CIBTP, PRO BTP, indemnités spécifiques) constitue un atout majeur,
- Outils : Vous êtes très à l'aise avec les outils informatiques et les télétransmissions déclaratives. La maîtrise ou la connaissance de SAGE est appréciée,
- Savoir être : Vous faites preuve de calme, de discrétion, de rigueur et d'une excellente capacité de recul,
- Potentiel : Réfléchi(e) et structuré(e), vous avez l'ambition de faire évoluer votre périmètre et de monter en compétences vers des responsabilités RH.

Pourquoi postuler ?

- Accompagnement de proximité : Formation et montée en charge adaptées à votre profil,
- Proximité & Transparence : Une culture d'entreprise basée sur la confiance et la clarté,
- Perspectives réelles : Une opportunité concrète d'évoluer à moyen terme dans le domaine des RH.

Pour postuler : Transmettez votre candidature à Oz2B afin d'échanger sur cette opportunité.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales afin de garantir une expérience fluide et qualitative pour les partenaires et les assurés.

Vous êtes diplômé d'un Bac+2 (BTS Assurance / Finance / Banque / Immobilier / Gestion), idéalement avec des expériences en assurance santé et / ou au sein d'un middle office. C'est toute de même votre personnalité qui nous intéresse avant tout !

Vous faites preuve de qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles, et vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens de l'écoute et votre polyvalence.

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous intégrez un collectif engagé : la bienveillance est le fondement de toutes nos relations.

Vous pourrez compter sur une forte dynamique d'entraide et de partage de connaissances afin de développer votre potentiel. Vous serez formé à nos outils ainsi qu'aux bases de l'assurance. Que vous soyez ou non issu du monde assurantiel, chez Henner nous vous proposerons un parcours qui vous ressemble, tout en étant accompagné en proximité.

- Assurer une veille continue du marché du travail afin de disposer d'une connaissance actualisée et approfondie du tissu socio-économique du territoire (département / région),

- Connaissances indispensables du bassin de l'emploi,

o des dispositifs France Travail, formation, création d'entreprise,

- Contrat 35h,

o Panier repas (8.20€ net) par jour travaillé sur site,

Conception Hardware

-         Concevoir des solutions de gestion d'énergie robustes, adaptées aux environnements industriels exigeants.
-         Développer et exploiter des bancs de test hardware.
-         Conduire des essais avancés : CEM, perturbations électriques, vibrations, endurance.
-         Interagir avec le service certification pour intégrer les exigences CE, CEM et ATEX dès la conception.
-         Contribuer à la cybersécurité matérielle (accès debug, protections, interfaces).
-         Rédiger la documentation technique associée (notes de conception, résultats de validation, spécifications).

title: Sales manager m/f (h/f) (H/F)
description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



SLS est le leader mondial des trains d'atterrissage, roues & freins, et systèmes associés, pour avions civils, militaires, hélicoptères. Nous maîtrisons l'ensemble du cycle de vie de nos produits, de la conception et la fabrication jusqu'à la maintenance.



Envie d'évoluer dans un environnement international, stimulant et bienveillant, au sein d'une entreprise à taille humaine ? Rejoignez-nous !



Vous ne remplissez pas 100 % des critères ? Ce n'est pas un frein pour nous. Ce que l'on recherche avant tout, ce sont des personnes créatives et engagées !



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionJob Overview:

The role requires frequent travel (approximately 30-50%) and involves engagement with stakeholders across all levels, from operational teams to senior executives (CEO/CFO/VP), both internally and externally.



Job Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Achieve Services Sales targets and support accurate sales forecasting at both local and international levels

2. Manage and grow a portfolio of existing customers while developing new business opportunities

3. Expand Safran Landing Systems' Landing Life Services footprint across assigned markets.

4. Analyze market trends, customer needs, competitive landscape, and pricing to drive sales strategy.

5. Act as the voice of the customer within the Services organization and represent the company to airlines, airframers, and MROs.

6. Identify, develop, and secure profitable business opportunities within the Services network.

7. Lead contract negotiations with customers, in collaboration with internal stakeholders including legal.

8. Manage landing gear/component intake forecasts and provide timely updates on changes within the assigned territory.

9. Drive internal alignment and improvements to better meet customer expectations.

o Manage production planning and master scheduling for each part numbers in adequation with customer needs and provide delivery commitments to customers.

description:
Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. As a technology specialist for advanced hardware, software, and connectivity, we play a key role in transferring Desay SV’s global innovation strength into tailored solutions for the European automotive market. Our corporate culture is characterized by dynamism, diversity, openness and fairness.

Desay SV Europe is part of Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd. based in China, a leading, stock exchange-listed provider of mobility solutions in the fields of Smart Cabin, Smart Drive and Smart Service. As a top 100 supplier and with its high level of technology expertise, Desay SV supports car manufacturers worldwide in their mobility transformation, making driving safer, more comfortable and more efficient.

We are looking for Senior System Architecture Engineer (m/f/d) in France

Your tasks

- As the onsite technical interface to customers, system architecture engineer shall lead technical proposal of project quotation, including requirement analysis and system design proposal.
- Responsible for system solution proposal, including:
1. Study RFI/RFQ documents from customer, analyze and clarify customer's requirement,
2. Leading/support System Concept Design proposal, coordinate R&D and output complete system solutions
3. Onsite TA (Technical Addendum) presentation and concern clarification,
4. Follow up questions raised by customers on technology assessment, and provide quick and professional service to customers, support them for the feasibility evaluation.
- Responsible for the product technology planning of strategic customers
- Act as an on-site technical window to customer for development project to support technical feasibility evaluation and explanation.

Your profile

- Many years of experience as system engineer in the automotive industry, ideally in the supplier industry in Europe,
- Well experienced of providing technical solution during quotation phase.
- Knowledge of the cockpit or ADAS domain controller
- Familiarity with current trends and technologies in the field of smart cockpit and autonomous driving
- Ability to analyze, summarize, coordinate and organize, define and refinerequirements.
- Ability to work in a team and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.
- Customer and solution-oriented thinking
- Excellent communication skills in English (is a must) and German (is a plus), Exceptional presentation and written skills (PowerPoint)
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related field
- Energetic, passionate, curiousness, open-minded, resilient, and self-drive
- Willingness to travel (1-2 times per month)

We offer

- Training and continuing education
- Individual training
- Company cell phone
- Company laptop
- 30 Vacation days per year
- Company car
- Parking lot
- Flexible working hours
- Mobile working
- Good traffic connections
- Employee bonuses
- Employee events
- Friendly and trustful colleagues
- Accident insurance (private and professional)

We look forward to receiving your application.

title: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): French/ English in Paris (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.
- Advise colleagues and customers on basic e-bike care, safe operation, and battery handling/storage best practices.
- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.
