title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients

- Aménagement du temps de travail sur 5 ou 6 jours selon l'organisation

Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Lonigo organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO per la figura di: Addetto/Addetta al Confezionamento dei Prodotti Alimentari Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 100 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: - Riferimenti normativi in materia di imprese, filiere e tracciabilità dei prodotti agroalimentari - Processi produttivi e lavorativi della filiera agro-alimentare - Riferimenti normativi in materia di HACCP e igiene dei prodotti alimentari - Proprietà e caratteristiche dei materiali delle soluzioni di packaging per il confezionamento dei prodotti alimentari solidi e liquidi - Tipologia, caratteristiche e funzionalità dei principali macchinari per il riempimento, il dosaggio dei prodotti e per la chiusura e sigillatura delle confezioni - Caratteristiche fisiche e biologiche dei prodotti alimentari solidi Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il corso, in modalità mista (lezioni online ed in presenza), avrà una durata di 100 ore e si svolgerà dal SETTEMBRE 2026 presso HOTEL CORTE QUADRI - Via Pontespin 17L - Lonigo La frequenza consente, in presenza dei requisiti previsti, il riconoscimento del Bonus Politiche Attive, da richiedere presso il Centro per l'Impiego (CPI) competente del territorio. description: Il settore ristorazione ti ha sempre affascinato? Ti piacerebbe svolgere un percorso di formazione gratuito per lavorare come addetto/a alle attività di distribuzione pasti presso mense aziendali e scolastiche, tavole calde e self-service? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Mirano organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO per la figura di: Operatore/Operatrice di Cucina Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 80 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: Organizzazione e funzionamento delle mense scolastiche e ospedaliere, tavole calde e self-service Struttura della mensa, principali mansioni e ruolo dell'addetto mensa Allestimento e pulizia degli ambienti, delle attrezzature e degli utensili di cucina nel rispetto delle norme HACCP Pulizia, sanificazione, disinfezione e disinfestazione igienico sanitaria di ambienti, attrezzature e utensili da cucina Operare la preparazione e somministrazione dei piatti nel rispetto delle norme HACCP Scodellamento, sporzionamento e gestione della sala Le muffe, i funghi e i lieviti: gli ambienti favorenti e processi di evitamento e prevenzione Controllare lo stato di conservazione delle materie prime e dei semilavorati alimentari stoccati Identificare ed utilizzare i materiali e le confezioni più indicate per proteggere gli alimenti da contaminazioni di tipo chimico e fisico, allungarne la conservazione e trasmettere le informazioni sul prodotto Tipologie di imballo e caratteristiche di utilizzo per il settore alimentare e celle frigorifere Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso avrà una durata di 80 e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) presso Confcommercio del Miranese -Via Firenze 12, 30035 - Mirano (VE). Per ogni ora di frequenza verrà riconosciuta un'indennità di frequenza, previa partecipazione ad almeno il 70% del Monte ore totale. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Delivery Manager - Riga, Latvia
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Delivery Manager, you will ensure smooth execution of technical deliveries by maintaining structure across tasks, builds, and milestones, while acting as a key coordination point between engineering, QA, and stakeholders. This is a hands-on role combining delivery coordination, build and deployment execution, and technical troubleshooting. You will work closely with teams to ensure builds are consistently delivered, tested, and available for review, while keeping communication clear and expectations aligned across all parties.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Delivery & Coordination

    Maintain structure and visibility across ongoing deliverables, tasks, and milestones.
    Track ownership and deadlines, follow up on progress, and ensure timely execution.
    Participate in internal and external meetings to capture requirements, decisions, and action items.
    Document outcomes of discussions to ensure clarity and continuity for the team.
    Maintain clear visibility of delivery status, dependencies, and potential risks.
    Support prioritization and coordination across teams without direct managerial authority.

Technical Execution

Work with existing tools and pipelines to:

    Create and manage builds.
    Deploy builds to target environments or devices.
    Prepare builds for internal testing and stakeholder review.
    Perform sanity checks, smoke testing, and basic validation of builds.
    Distribute deliverables to stakeholders and collect feedback.
    Troubleshoot build, deployment, or environment-related issues where possible.
    Act as a practical technical support layer for delivery and release activities.

Communication & Stakeholder Support

    Serve as a point of contact for delivery updates and build availability.
    Translate technical progress into clear, structured, and actionable updates.
    Ensure alignment of expectations between technical teams and stakeholders.
    Support transparent and consistent communication across all involved parties.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

    Strong hands-on technical background (software, tools, or build systems relevant to the team).
    Experience with build systems, deployment workflows, or CI/CD pipelines.
    Ability to set up, run, and test builds independently.
    Comfortable working with existing tools and adapting to new ones quickly.
    Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
    Professional proficient in spoken and written English (knowledge of English is required, as the company is international and it is necessary to communicate in English with foreign colleagues daily).
    Excellent organization and task-tracking abilities.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    Comfortable working across disciplines (engineering, QA, stakeholders).
    High attention to detail and follow-through.
    Proactive, self-driven, and reliable.

NICE TO HAVE

    Experience in game development, software delivery, or technical production roles.
    Familiarity with Agile or iterative development workflows.
    Previous experience acting as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
    Basic scripting or automation experience.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

    Monthly salary from 3700 EUR to 5500 EUR gross/per month.
    Health insurance from the first day of employment.
    Paid parking next to the office as required.
    On-site work model: 5 days from the office.
    Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development.
    Taking part in creating studios as part of an award-winning iGaming business.
    Truly international experience and collaboration possibilities with impactful results.

title: BIM Technician - Riga, Latvia
description:
Our global team of over 10,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.

At ARRISE, we take pride in creating growth opportunities at all levels, constantly investing in our people while welcoming new colleagues and forging strategic partnerships that open new opportunities for success.

To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.

Be part of the future of iGaming with 10,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a BIM Technician to join our Studio Design Team in Riga. The role requires a strong understanding of architectural and interior design principles to ensure that all BIM content and documentation meet project requirements. You will work across all design stages, from concept to delivery, supporting both local and international projects.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

    Guide design stages from concept development to final documentation.
    Develop and maintain detailed BIM models, families, and specifications.
    Prepare accurate data for printing, production, and project documentation.
    Assist in sourcing materials and products required for design projects.
    Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
    Estimate required time for deliverables and manage deadlines effectively.
    Actively participate in team meetings and brainstorming sessions.
    Ensure all project deliverables are completed on time and in line with team guidelines.
    Proactively suggest new solutions, processes, and structures to improve efficiency.
    Conduct site visits and travel to business locations to collect planning data.
    Facilitate effective use of Revit and cloud-based collaboration systems (e.g., BIM 360).

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

    Proficiency in BIM software such as Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD (including cloud-based workflows such as BIM 360).
    Strong ability to create and manage BIM content, including families, templates, and libraries, in line with best practices.
    Experience with 2D and 3D models.
    Knowledge of other CAD software or data analytics tools is considered an advantage.
    Excellent collaboration and communication skills across teams and cultures.
    Professional proficient in spoken and written English (knowledge of English is required, as the company is international and it is necessary to communicate in English with foreign colleagues daily).

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

    Monthly salary from 2250 EUR to 2700 EUR gross/per month.
    Health insurance from the first day of employment.
    Paid parking next to the office as required.
    Hybrid work model: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.
    Taking part in creating studios as part of an award-winning iGaming business.
    Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development.
    Truly international experience and collaboration possibilities with impactful results.

However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. Profil Compétences techniques Solide expérience en administration de systèmes et d'infrastructures informatiques; Très bonne connaissance des environnements Microsoft Windows Server; Bonne maîtrise des services Active Directory et LDAP; Bonnes connaissances des infrastructures réseaux (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routage, firewall); Expérience dans l'exploitation d'environnements de production; Connaissances en monitoring et supervision des infrastructures; Bonne compréhension des principes de cybersécurité et de gestion des accès; Expérience dans l'analyse et la résolution d'incidents complexes; Capacité à travailler sur des infrastructures faisant intervenir plusieurs...

title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Intéressé(e) ? title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

Employees work in a hybrid mode Work 2 days from home (unless working cross-border)

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,600 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world's leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

Job Description

This is a new and exciting opportunity to join Avaloq as our Head of Key Account Management in the Luxembourg office. You will shape and manage the Key Management team across Region Europe to drive the overall existing business performance across the region. You'll stimulate regional growth by steering the sales strategy, achieving financial targets and expanding our client base. In tandem with your technical and strategic tasks, you will ensure exceptional delivery, performance and client satisfaction.

• Manage commercial matters including contract governance, pricing discussions, upselling, renewals, and revenue forecasting as part of driving retention and revenue growth
• Enforce accurate forecasting, weekly updates of CRM sales data, and adherence to 'Road to Home' KPI expectations
• Coordinate with Global Sales Operations, Regional Controlling, and Finance for revenue recognition and deal structure validation, ensuring consistent offering processes, billing and account administration oversight
• Contribute to regional governance structures, including collaboration with Sales, Project Delivery, AMS, CTO and Strategy functions
• Lead, motivate, and develop teams to promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and customer-centric performance ensuring team cohesion across Region Europe

Qualifications

• 10+ years of proven experience leading high-performing teams in Sales or a similar role, ideally within the banking, wealth management, or fintech industry
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage
• Fluent in written and spoken English and German (C1) to proficiently communicate with range of colleagues and clients
• Demonstrable success identifying opportunities and executing up-selling to banks, preferably in software and/or wealth management products in both On-Premises and SaaS Models
• A profound C-Level network to leverage on high value connections to drive business success
• Exemplary client relationship management skills across project delivery and service operations, led by refined interpersonal skills during cross-regional collaboration, facilitation and negotiation

Additional Information

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

Our base salaries are competitive and you can be recognised for outstanding effort with an extraordinary achievement reward – the pinnacle of recognition.

In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique.

The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.

Your role

Teaching:

The holder of the position will contribute to the Bachelor of Science in Nursing, specialisation: Surgery (“Bachelor Assistance Technique Médicale de Chirurgie”). The selected candidate is expected to co-organize the bachelor programme. The individual will contribute to establish the training plan for specialized nurses, contribute to organize theoretical and practical teaching, and the evaluation during and at the end of the course, in relation with the teachers and tutors of the clinical placements. More particularly, the presence on the campus of students in medicine, biology, nursing and midwifery provides us with the possibility to establish common courses, to help students discover and understand the specificities of their different training and future professions at a very early stage and to have them work together in modern interprofessional simulation environments. This pooling of teaching will be based on the collaborative and joint work of teachers from the different health programmes.

Research:

The candidate will be responsible for developing the research programme and to contribute, according to one's expertise, to the current Nursing Education Research Programmes.

Your profile

• Holder of a Nursing degree, a master's preferably in Nursing Science and a doctorate (PhD) preferably in Nursing Science or in Public Health. • Administrative experience and leadership qualities are essential
• Experience in both nursing research and nursing education, including theoretical teaching and supervision of trainees, is essential
• Clinical experience in Perioperative Nursing
• Connection to nursing education departments in universities abroad
• Collaboration or membership with European Nursing Societies
• Experience in simulation training and being a holder of ERC certificate are considered as an asset

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities

title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A (m/f)
description:
Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
Job ID: 10465601 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities

- Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure
- Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
- Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
- Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy
- Onboard, develop and mentor team members in areas of financial reporting for accuracy, create best practice materials and promote knowledge sharing

A day in the life

Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. A significant portion of your time is dedicated to leading Quadrant reporting for Cost-to-Serve, requiring close partnership with Operations teams to ensure alignment and accurate representation of financial impacts.

About the team

Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.

Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree
- Experience in multiple finance and accounting roles, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL or Tableau
- Experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related field
- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

description:
Global Trade Compliance (GTC) Senior PM, EMEA Customs Compliance Governance, EMEA Global Trade Compliance
Job ID: 10491106 | Amazon Kuiper Services Europe SARL

Description

The GTC EMEA PM Customs Compliance Governance role is a strategic position responsible for driving comprehensive trade compliance excellence across Amazon's Leo EMEA operations. This role combines customs regulatory requirements and operational execution, ensuring seamless implementation of evolving EMEA legislative frameworks including CBAM obligations while maintaining Amazon's commitment to compliance excellence. The position requires a dynamic, experienced professional who can navigate complex cross-functional partnerships, develop robust operational processes, and translate regulatory requirements into actionable business strategies.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities

Compliance Implementation & Management

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams as well as GTC internal teams incl. HS classification team, valuation or export controls team on the strategies to implement and manage legislative requirements, including CBAM management and reporting obligations
• Partner with business units to proactively identify compliance risks and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements
• Work with leaders, across Amazon to identify customs optimization opportunities and influence development of new compliance programs, products, and services

Process Development & Documentation

• Develop, document, and maintain comprehensive operational processes and procedures
• Identify and address information or process gaps through coordination with internal partners incl. expansions team and export controls team as well as external stakeholders
• Drive continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency

Performance Management & Reporting

• Contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and success metrics for customs compliance activities in EMEA region
• Maintain rigorous standards for meeting the compliance KPIs

Regulatory Monitoring & Communication

• Track and analyze import/export regulatory and business changes affecting EMEA region customs operations
• Communicate regulatory guidelines clearly to stakeholders throughout the export/import planning lifecycle

Training & Communication

• Design and implement communication and strategic training programs to ensure internal and external partners understand and align with trade and product compliance processes
• Promote awareness and alignment across all stakeholder groups regarding compliance requirements and procedures

Leadership Support

• Provide regular reporting and insights to the EMEA GTC Lead
• Support global GTC initiatives and projects for Amazon Leo
• Represent EMEA region in global GTC forums and discussions
• Contribute to strategic planning for trade compliance improvements

About the team

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space-based systems design and wireless systems.

- Experience in written and spoken English and an ability to compose grammatically correct, concise and accurate written responses
- • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, International Business, Logistics, or related field
- • Experience in global trade compliance, customs operations, or related roles
- • Knowledge of customs regulations in EMEA countries, incl. tariff classification, customs valuation, product origin and FTA agreements.
- • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements

Preferred Qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in French
- Master's degree in related field or professional certification (e.g., Certified Customs Broker)

title: Sales Manager (m/f)
description:
Sales Manager

Employees work in a hybrid mode: Work 2 days from home, cross-border workers work on-site
Full-time

Company Description

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,600 colleagues in 11 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world's leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

Job Description

We have a fantastic opportunity for an experienced sales manager to help drive further growth in the wealth management and private banking European market with a focus on the German and Austrian markets. Reporting to the head of sales as part of the Sales & Key Account Management team, you will join an experienced and high achieving team and have the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing success of Avaloq .

We are looking for someone who is highly capable, driven, ambitious and self-motivated, who wants to contribute to a strong and collaborative team spirit.

Your primary role will be to tirelessly acquire, qualify and close material sales opportunities for our core platform, digital and ‘as-a-Service' products.  In doing so you will:

• Actively create and drive pipeline by identifying, matching and engaging Financial Institutions by identifying key stakeholders, buyers and decision makers in Private Banking, Wealth and Asset Management with our products and services;
• Implement successful sales strategies for designated sales projects and support definition of business cases for prospective clients including the Coordination of meetings with prospective clients as well as internal resources; prepare and hold presentations and workshops, and liaise with the business in order to arrange management of the delivery.
• Reach sales targets by initiating and managing sales projects until the conclusion of contracts with new clients;
• For international accounts, contribute to a multi-site sales strategy in partnership with the leading sales executive/manager
• Channel market feedback to collaborate with our solutions, pre-sales and product teams to drive the development of product features that will generate new business.

Qualifications

• Proven track record and experience of developing and winning material and profitable new business within the financial & wealth management industry with experience of complex deal structuring experience including lift outs of technology and operations
• Relevant experience in – front/middle and back office systems and services in the wealth management and private banking space
• Proven track record of building strong engagement with key stakeholders by utilizing your resilience, drive and an insatiable hunger to find, create and win new business
• Excellent analytical, communication,  presentation and proposal (RFI/RFP) skills
• Willingness to travel
• Fluent in English and German.

Additional Information

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

Our base salaries are competitive and you can be recognised for outstanding effort with an extraordinary achievement reward – the pinnacle of recognition.

In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.

We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

title: Cartographe (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Conservation et expertise: Assurer la préservation des documents (conditions de stockage, restauration si nécessaire); Participer à des projets de recherche en lien avec les collections, en collaboration avec des institutions nationales ou internationales. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience avérée en: Catalogage de documents patrimoniaux (normes RDA, Rameau, DDC); Gestion de SIGB (idéalement Alma); Numérisation et valorisation de collections spéciales; Maîtrise des outils de traitement d'images, de métadonnées et de bases de données bibliographiques; Connaissances en conservation préventive des documents anciens et fragiles; Rigueur et précision : capacité à travailler avec des documents uniques et parfois fragiles; Esprit d'initiative : proposition de solutions innovant/antes pour améliorer l'accessibilité des collections; Collaboration : travail en équipe avec les autres services de la BnL (patrimoine, IT, communication); Sens de la médiation : aptitude à rendre les collections compréhensibles et attractives pour le public. Compétences comportementales Conceptualiser : Vous pensez de façon abstraite à l'aide de concepts, vous modélisez et simulez le futur pour concevoir des solutions réalistes; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulier/ière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Atouts Connaissance du contexte luxembourgeois (histoire, géographie, institutions culturelles); Expérience dans la gestion de projets liés au patrimoine ou à la numérisation. title: Expert Ressources Humaines (m/f) (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)

Le CCSS offre un cadre de travail motivant: En mettant en œuvre une mission légale essentielle pour le Luxembourg; En étant installé dans un bâtiment moderne; En étant localisé idéalement en face de la gare de Luxembourg à proximité immédiate de tous les moyens de transports, dans un quartier en renouveau et facile d'accès; En offrant la formation initiale complétée par la formation continue offerte à tous les agents du service public; En offrant une rémunération en ligne avec les conditions de la Fonction publique. title: Chef de Service - Secrétariat Général (m/f) (m/f) (H/F)
description: Mission Dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre du plan de succession hiérarchique dans le service « Secrétariat Général » (SG), la CSSF recherche un Chef de Service (m/f) à temps plein. Rôle & responsabilités Le chef de service : En tant que secrétaire général(e) de la CSSF, coordonne activement la mise en œuvre des missions du secrétariat général de la CSSF, dont la qualification juridique des activités relevant de la loi du 5 avril  relative au secteur financier, la communication externe et interne, les relations avec la presse et le développement de l'éducation financier/ière. Conseille la direction en proposant les mesures propres à améliorer le fonctionnement de la CSSF, notamment sur des sujets transversaux et la gestion des connaissances. Organise le secrétariat du Conseil et du Comité de direction de la CSSF. Représente la CSSF auprès d'institutions nationales et internationales en relation avec l'activité de son service et assume les travaux de préparation et de suivi afférents. Dirige et coordonne les activités et projets du service. Il/elle gère les membres de son service. Rapporte au directeur général de la CSSF. Veille à la continuité des missions confiées au service. Identifie les risques liés à l'activité de son service (i.e. risque d'image, risque d'erreurs ou de fraudes) et prend les mesures préventives adéquates. Votre profil Diplôme d'études supérieures universitaires (Bac +4 / Bac +5) en droit, sciences économiques, finance ou administration et gestion des entreprises; Une expérience professionnelle confirmée dans le management et le domaine de la surveillance du secteur financier; Bonnes connaissances du cadre réglementaire applicable au secteur financier, notamment de la loi du 5 avril  relative au secteur financier et son interaction avec des sujets transversaux; Très bonne maîtrise à l'écrit et à l'oral du français, de l'allemand et de l'anglais, la maîtrise orale du luxembourgeois constitue un avantage; Bonnes capacités managériales, rédactionnelles, d'analyse et de synthèse; Aptitude pour gérer de multiples dossiers évoluant en parallèle; Rigueur et sens de l'organisation; Bonnes compétences relationnelles et de communication; Flexibilité et sens de l'initiative; Expérience avérée en gestion d'équipe comme une capacité de travailler de façon autonome. Le(la) candidat(e) retenu(e) sera engagé(e) comme employé(e) de l'État en vertu d'un contrat à durée indéterminée. Si le(la) candidat(e) remplit les conditions en vigueur, il/elle sera amené(e) à se présenter par la suite à l'admission au statut de fonctionnaire de l'État. Avant la conclusion du contrat de travail, le(la) candidat(e) devra délivrer un extrait du  (bulletin n°3), datant de moins de 2 mois, afin de garantir son honorabilité.

title: Assistant(e) Technique Fr-All (H/F)
description: Sofitex Talent Recruitment Fort d'une expérience de plus de  ans dans les Ressources Humaines, Sofitex est un réseau international de Travail Temporaire et de Placement . Sofitex fonde sa dynamique et son succès sur le professionnalisme de ses équipes, sa forte réactivité et sa proximité. POSTE Pour l'un de nos clients, une société située à Leudelange, Sofitex Talent recherche pour un démarrage en septembre un(e) Assistant(e) Technique Fr-All (H/F) Vos tâches: Gérer le premier niveau de support avec les clients : - Entretenir la relation client et résoudre les problèmes dans les délais définis dans le contrat initial conformément aux processus internes ; - Fournir au client des informations précises d'un point de vue technique ; - Rapporter les demandes du client à sa hiérarchie et proposer toute amélioration visant à répondre au mieux à ses attentes Activités et taches principales : - Exécuter le programme de travail tel définit dans la fiche de poste liées aux projets - Réaliser et assurer la mise à jour de : - la documentation des interventions - la plateforme de communication intranet et extranet en rapport, document technique, instruction... - la définition des compteurs - l'inventaire des installations et participer à la définition des gammes de maintenance - la nomenclature des installations à entretenir (inventaire, gamme d'entretien, fréquence, ...) - les fiches signalétiques des projets - le suivi des KPIs - du registre de sécurité - la planification des ressources (interne et externe) affectées aux projets; - Coordonne, pilote et documente les prestations des intervenants (interne et externe) - S'assurer : - de la tenue à jour du journal d'exploitation « On site » et « On line » - de la réalisation hebdomadaire de la conduite des énergies et de la cohérence des données collectées - Introduire et initier : - les demandes d'achat et avaliser les « bons de commande » et factures relatives - les demandes de facturation client et avaliser les factures relatives - Effectuer des études, calculs et analyses techniques ; - Rédiger des rapports, des instructions de travail et descriptifs de fonctionnement ; - Membre actif d'un ou plusieurs centres de compétences. Suit régulier/ièrement des formations spécifiques à ces activités ; - Participer et proposer des optimisations des énergies - Encadrer techniquement le personnel « On site » et avaliser les congés et rapports hebdomadaire PROFIL - Issu d'une filier/ière technique et titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac ou équivalent et une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine de l'électricité. - Langues : français et allemand courants, pratique du luxembourgeois et de l'anglais souhaitable. - Rigueur et motivation, qualités rédactionnelles, capacité de synthèse et sens des priorités. - Ecoute active, patience, sens des relations humaines, des facultés d'adaptation et autonomie. - Informatique : Microsoft Package (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) et Microsoft SharePoint, Pit-FM souhaités. Poste à pourvoir rapidement, en contrat CDI. Salaire:  à EUR brut + eme mois + prime de gratification
